decisions_and_limits.authority: No actual trusted grant or native caller. Static __used noinline seam only, compiled under explicit built-in development guard.
decisions_and_limits.caller_contract: Future separately admitted owner must retain independent live md/table/target lifetime and exact immutable key, fence all external upper producers and selected-area activity, enter without conflicting locks and drop its independent refs before ordinary removal. Exact key and registration not admission authority.
decisions_and_limits.retained_holder: Exactly one reservation-owned md holder until READY; EBUSY retry and permanent-error quarantine intentionally retain it and exact identity; no public reset/recovery.
decisions_and_limits.deferred_close: Success from retire_registered is not final close. Check real open count and deferred/requeue debt, keep fence and avoid replay after success, never force close.
decisions_and_limits.ordinary_deletion: Existing native gate remains mandatory and only consumes readiness after real open count zero; competing selected removal gets EAGAIN, never falsely acknowledges deferred; unrelated and guard-off paths unchanged.
decisions_and_limits.forced_direct_destroy: Pinned built-in ordinary/deferred path uses native gate; forced dm_hash_remove_all(0) is init-failure/module-exit path. Defensive __dm_destroy guard refuses unexpected bypass before destructive side effects; void ABI cannot report an error to a hypothetical future direct caller already past hash unlink. Intentional fail-closed retention, not general recovery; review any future bypass before composition.
decisions_and_limits.destruction_witness: DESTROYED is table destruction return, not final mapped-device close/free or CLEANUP proof; no table/target pointer used after dtr. free_dev follows.
decisions_and_limits.first_error: Permanent callback error preserved; retryable EBUSY not permanent. Stale initial complete key rejected by frozen callback, reservation quarantined; no guessed-key positive grant.
